Menu.Name: Creature art
Menu.Label: Manage creature art
Menu.Hint: Replace the PF2e compendium creature images with this module's art, and apply it to creatures already in the world.

Manager.Title: Creature art

Compendium.Heading: Compendium
Compendium.Intro: Shows this module's art on PF2e compendium creatures, and on any creature you add from a compendium. The PF2e compendiums themselves are not modified, so this can be undone at any time.
Compendium.StatusOff: Status: compendium images are the PF2e defaults.
Compendium.Reload: Reload now so every compendium shows the change? Other players should reload too.

Manager.Intro: World NPCs only. Portraits and tokens are replaced only while they still show a default image. Creatures with a token on any scene are left alone.
Manager.ConfirmApply: Apply creature art to {count} world NPCs? You can revert this later.
Manager.ConfirmRevert: Restore the original images on {count} world NPCs? Images you changed yourself since applying are kept.
